issues.description: patch_description does not follow the serial-number-prefixed format specified in the code style rules. Current descriptions are plain English ('Add HarmonyOS detection to config.guess', 'Fix umask 077 to 022 for HMDFS compatibility'). The code style example expects format like '0001 build aux config.guess' with the serial number prefix.
issues.suggestion: Consider updating patch_description to follow the 'NNNN <space-separated-words>' convention, e.g., '0001 config guess HarmonyOS detection' and '0002 configure umask fix'.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'software:' field name instead of 'name:' and nested 'build: system:' instead of 'build_system:' as specified in the code style rules. The version-level manifest also uses 'software:' instead of 'name:'. While the semantics are correct, the field names differ from the documented format.
issues.suggestion: If this is an intentional project-wide convention that supersedes the code style example, consider documenting the deviation. Otherwise, align field names with the code style spec (name:, build_system:).

issues.description: The commented-out line in test() references os.path.join but the 'os' module is not imported. If someone uncomments this line, it will cause a NameError at runtime.
issues.suggestion: Either add 'import os' to the file or remove the commented-out alternative to avoid confusion.

summary: Audit PASS for ngtcp2 1.22.1 Conan recipe. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. All critical checks verified: (1) conandata.yml sha256 is a valid 64-char hex hash (not a placeholder, not all zeros/f's); (2) conanfile.py url field is non-empty, requirements()/generate()/package_info() are correctly implemented using Conan 2.x API with proper method ordering; (3) test_package/test.c genuinely calls ngtcp2 APIs (ngtcp2_version and ngtcp2_pkt_write_version_negotiation) — not a shell/printf-only test; (4) both patches use correct a/ b/ diff format with real platform adaptation logic (HarmonyOS detection in config.guess, umask 077->022 fix in configure); (5) patch filenames are consistent across conandata.yml, notes.md, manifest.yaml, and actual files in patches/ directory; (6) no template placeholders (TODO/FIXME/REPLACE_WITH) found in any file; (7) no pre-compiled binaries or prohibited files. Three minor issues flagged: two P2 code style warnings (patch_description format and manifest field naming) and one P3 hint (missing 'import os' for commented-out code in test_package/conanfile.py). None of these block the PR.
